queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM engine.systems

SELECT
                COUNT(*) as total,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN batch_status = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 END) as active
            FROM engine.migration_batch_registry
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM engine.controls

SELECT
                id,
                action,
                entity_type,
                entity_id,
                user_email,
                timestamp
            FROM engine.audit_log
            ORDER BY timestamp DESC
            LIMIT 5

SELECT
                COUNT(*) as total,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN batch_status = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 END) as running,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN batch_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) as completed,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN batch_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) as failed
            FROM engine.migration_batch_registry

SELECT
                batch_id,
                project_id,
                batch_status,
                batch_start_time
            FROM engine.migration_batch_registry
            WHERE batch_status IN ('RUNNING', 'PENDING')
            ORDER BY batch_start_time DESC
            LIMIT 5

SELECT
                batch_id,
                project_id,
                batch_status,
                total_controls,
                completed_controls,
                failed_controls,
                batch_start_time,
                batch_end_time
            FROM engine.migration_batch_registry
            ORDER BY batch_start_time DESC
            LIMIT 5

SELECT
                id,
                action,
                entity_type,
                entity_id,
                user_email,
                timestamp,
                details
            FROM engine.audit_log
            WHERE 1=1
         ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT
                id,
                entity_type,
                entity_id,
                status,
                requested_by,
                created_at
            FROM engine.approvals
            WHERE status = 'PENDING'
            ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT
                id,
                entity_type,
                entity_id,
                reason,
                status,
                requested_by,
                created_at
            FROM engine.exceptions
            WHERE status = 'OPEN'
            ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT
                batch_id,
                project_id,
                overall_status,
                overall_score,
                execution_start,
                execution_end
            FROM engine.migration_validation_batch
            WHERE batch_id = 8780c73b-1267-4424-aa46-478a1f3c0f9e

SELECT
                control_id,
                overall_status,
                total_rules,
                passed_rules,
                failed_rules,
                error_rules
            FROM engine.migration_control_summary
            WHERE batch_id = 8780c73b-1267-4424-aa46-478a1f3c0f9e
            ORDER BY control_id

SELECT
                batch_id,
                project_id,
                migration_status,
                blocking_controls,
                total_failed_rules,
                decision_time
            FROM engine.migration_governance_status
            WHERE batch_id = 8780c73b-1267-4424-aa46-478a1f3c0f9e

SELECT
                batch_id,
                risk_score,
                risk_level,
                calculated_timestamp
            FROM engine.migration_risk_scores
            WHERE batch_id = 8780c73b-1267-4424-aa46-478a1f3c0f9e
            ORDER BY calculated_timestamp DESC
            LIMIT 1

SELECT
                exception_id,
                batch_id,
                control_id,
                rule_id,
                entity_name,
                source_value,
                target_value,
                delta_value,
                cause,
                failure_scope,
                created_at
            FROM engine.migration_control_exceptions
            WHERE batch_id = 8780c73b-1267-4424-aa46-478a1f3c0f9e
            ORDER BY control_id, rule_id

SELECT
                execution_status,
                COALESCE(severity_level, 'LOW')
            FROM engine.migration_control_execution
            WHERE batch_id = 8780c73b-1267-4424-aa46-478a1f3c0f9e

SELECT batch_id, batch_status
            FROM engine.migration_batch_registry
            WHERE batch_id = 8780c73b-1267-4424-aa46-478a1f3c0f9e

SELECT
                id,
                batch_id,
                event_type,
                event_timestamp,
                details
            FROM engine.migration_batch_lifecycle
            WHERE batch_id = 8780c73b-1267-4424-aa46-478a1f3c0f9e
            ORDER BY event_timestamp ASC

SELECT
                batch_id,
                batch_status,
                total_controls,
                completed_controls,
                failed_controls
            FROM engine.migration_batch_registry
            WHERE batch_id = 8780c73b-1267-4424-aa46-478a1f3c0f9e

SELECT
                batch_id,
                project_id,
                batch_status,
                total_controls,
                completed_controls,
                failed_controls,
                batch_start_time,
                batch_end_time
            FROM engine.migration_batch_registry
            WHERE batch_id = 8780c73b-1267-4424-aa46-478a1f3c0f9e

SELECT
                id,
                batch_id,
                control_id,
                rule_id,
                entity_name,
                execution_status,
                delta_value,
                execution_time_seconds,
                severity_level,
                created_at
            FROM engine.migration_control_execution
            WHERE batch_id = 8780c73b-1267-4424-aa46-478a1f3c0f9e
            ORDER BY control_id, rule_id
